words.zh: 1. 外觀，外表 2. 出現，顯露
words.en: the way someone or something looks; the act of arriving or being seen
ex: According to a university official, the new policy is part of an effort to improve the campus's appearance.
據一位大學行政人員說，新政策是改善校園形象工作的一部分。
roots: 出現、看得見（拉丁文 parere = appear）
colloc: by/from/to all appearances 從一切跡象來看
make one's first appearance 初次登場
respectable appearance 體面的外表

words.zh: 1. 傳達 2. 交流 3. 傳染
words.en: to share information, ideas, or feelings with someone
ex: And you are going to communicate that excitement to the people you are teaching.
你要把這份興奮傳達給你教的人。
roots: 共同的、共有（拉丁文 communis = common）
deriv: communicative a. 交際的；通訊的

words.zh: ad. 1. 連續地 2. 立即 3. 直截了當地；a. 1. 筆直的 2. 正直的 3. 連續的
words.en: continuously, without a break; in a direct line
ex: First, most students just cannot concentrate for three hours straight.
首先，大多數學生就是沒辦法連續專心三個小時。
colloc: go straight 改邪歸正

words.zh: v. 1.（square away）整頓，辦妥，了結 2. 使成平方 3. 使成正方形 4. 使打成平局；a. 1. 平方的 2. 正方形的；n. 1. 平方 2. 正方形 3. 廣場
words.en: (square away) to settle or arrange something properly; a shape with four equal sides
ex: I had some fines this semester, but that's been squared away.
這學期我確實被開過罰單，但已經處理好了。
roots: 四（拉丁文 quattuor = four）；square 原意是「弄成四方」
colloc: square away 處理妥當

words.zh: 1. 教學，教誨 2. 指令，說明
words.en: teaching or training; a statement telling someone what to do
ex: Regular evaluations of teachers help to ensure that students receive high-quality instruction.
定期評鑑教師，有助於確保學生得到高品質的教學。
roots: 建造、堆疊（拉丁文 struere = build）
colloc: instruction after class 課外指導
deriv: instructional a. 指導的，教育的

words.zh: n. 1. 得分，比分 2.（電影或戲劇的）配樂 3. 二十；v. 1. 得（分），贏得 2. 刻痕
words.en: the number of points someone gets in a test or game
ex: Should teachers be evaluated based on their students' test scores?
應該根據學生的考試成績來評鑑老師嗎？
colloc: scores of 很多

words.zh: 允許，許可，准許
words.en: the act of allowing someone to do something
ex: Teachers often ask school administrators for permission to take their students on field trips.
老師常向學校行政人員申請帶學生校外教學的許可。
roots: 送、放行（拉丁文 mittere = send, let go）
deriv: permit v. 允許，許可 n. 執照，許可證

words.zh: n. [ˈsɜːrveɪ] 調查；v. [sərˈveɪ] 調查
words.en: a set of questions asked to many people to find out their opinions
ex: The dean of admissions asked her to conduct the survey.
招生主任請她進行這項調查。
roots: 看（拉丁文 videre = see）；sur- = over，從上方看
look: 字尾 -vey 一樣，意思無關
colloc: survey feedback 調查回饋

words.zh: v. 1. 束縛，約束 2.（用線、繩等）繫，拴 3. 打成平手；n. 1. 領帶 2. 平手
words.en: to fasten something with string or rope; (be tied up) to be very busy
ex: I'm tied up at the moment.
我現在走不開。
colloc: be tied up 忙得走不開

words.zh: 1. 具體的，明確的 2. 特定的，特有的
words.en: clearly and exactly stated; relating to one particular thing
ex: I am curious if he mentioned any specific requirements.
我很好奇他有沒有提到任何具體要求。
deriv: specifically ad. 明確地；特定地

words.zh: 1. 影響 2.（在感情上）打動 3.（疾病、疼痛等）侵襲，感染 4. 假裝
words.en: to produce a change in someone or something; to influence
ex: Online library databases will not be affected.
線上圖書館資料庫不會受影響。
roots: 做、製作（拉丁文 facere = do, make）
look: 最常搞混：affect 多當動詞，effect 多當名詞

words.zh: a. 1. 學術的 2. 學院的，學校的 3. 學習好的；n. 大學教師
words.en: relating to schools, colleges, and studying
ex: A university's academic reputation is the most important thing a student should consider in deciding which university to attend.
學生決定要讀哪所大學時，最該考量的是學校的學術聲譽。
colloc: academic background 學術背景
academic qualification 學歷；學術資格
deriv: academy n. 專科院校；學會

words.zh: 宣布，宣告，通知
words.en: to tell people something officially or publicly
ex: We are pleased to announce that the university's annual drama festival will be held next Friday at six p.m. in the auditorium.
我們很高興通知各位，學校年度戲劇節將於下週五晚上 6 點在禮堂舉行。
roots: 說、報告（拉丁文 nuntiare = report）
deriv: announcer n. 播音員，廣播員

words.zh: n. 1. 尊重 2. 重視 3. 方面；v. 1. 尊重 2. 遵守
words.en: a feeling that someone is good or important; a particular detail
ex: Anaximander disagreed with his teacher despite his respect for him.
Anaximander 儘管尊重老師，還是不同意老師的觀點。
roots: 看（拉丁文 specere = look）；re- = back，回頭看 → 重視
colloc: in many respects/in this respect 在許多方面／在這方面
in respect of/with respect to 關於，就……而言
deriv: respectable a. 得體的，值得尊敬的
respected a. 受到廣泛尊重的
respective a. 分別的，各自的
respectively ad. 分別地，各自地

words.zh: n. 東西，材料；v. 1. 填滿 2. 吃飽
words.en: things or material of any kind; to fill something tightly
ex: And I wouldn't have much time to study the stuff in the book before the test.
而且考試前我沒有太多時間讀書裡的東西。
colloc: stuff and nonsense 胡說八道
stuff with 用……裝／填

words.zh: 1. 行業，職業 2. 聲稱，表明，宣布
words.en: a type of job that needs special training or skill
ex: They might offer scholarships to students planning to join their profession.
他們也許會提供獎學金給打算進入該行業的學生。
roots: 說、承認（拉丁文 fateri = confess）；pro- = 公開
colloc: enter/go into/join a profession 進入某一行業
deriv: professionalization n. 專業化，職業化

words.zh: 1. 作業，任務 2. 分配，指派
words.en: a piece of work given to someone as part of their studies or job
ex: I need to submit my assignment by tomorrow.
我明天之前必須交作業。
roots: 記號、標誌（拉丁文 signum = mark）
colloc: do one's assignment 做作業

words.zh: 合格的，勝任的，有資格的
words.en: having the training or skills needed for a particular job
ex: Bill, we have several qualified applicants we're serious about.
Bill，我們認真考慮了幾位合格的應徵者。
roots: 性質、種類（拉丁文 qualis = of what kind）
colloc: qualified for 有擔任……的資格
deriv: qualify v.（使）具有資格，（使）合格

words.zh: 校園，校區
words.en: the land and buildings of a university or college
ex: Please plan accordingly and consider using the library or the campus cafe during this time.
請據此做好安排，這段期間可考慮使用圖書館或校園咖啡廳。
roots: 原野、平地（拉丁文 campus = field）
colloc: on campus 在校內

words.zh: v. 指導，訓練；n. 1. 教練 2. 經濟艙 3. 四輪大馬車
words.en: to train or teach someone, especially in a sport
ex: He also coaches the swim team.
他也指導游泳隊。
colloc: assistant coach 助理教練
head coach 主教練，總教練

words.zh: 1. 窘迫的，尷尬的 2. 拮据的，經濟困難的
words.en: feeling uncomfortable or ashamed in front of other people
ex: He is embarrassed because he knows he did not put much time into this assignment.
他覺得很尷尬，因為他知道自己在這份作業上沒花多少時間。
roots: 橫桿、阻擋（法文 barre = bar）；em- = 放進，被擋住 → 窘迫
look: -ed 是人感到，-ing 是事物令人
deriv: embarrass v. 使尷尬，使窘迫

words.zh: 1. 典禮，儀式 2. 禮貌，禮節
words.en: a formal public event held for a special occasion
ex: Will I see you at the opening ceremony?
開幕典禮上會見到你嗎？
colloc: graduation ceremony 畢業典禮

words.zh: v. 1. 僱用 2. 租用；n. 租用
words.en: to employ someone; to pay to use something for a short time
ex: We have schools of course as a place for children to be educated and teachers are hired to actually educate the students, right?
當然，我們有學校作為孩子受教育的地方，也會僱用老師來實際教育學生，對吧？

words.zh: 圖表
words.en: a drawing that shows how numbers or amounts relate to each other
ex: Remember the graph I showed you?
還記得我給你看的那張圖表嗎？
deriv: graphic a. 圖示的；生動的
telegraph n. 電報 v. 發電報

words.zh: 1. 方便的，省事的 2. 附近的，近便的
words.en: easy to use or suitable for your plans; near and easy to reach
ex: Serving as a volunteer is not only helpful to communities, but also beneficial and convenient for students.
當志工不僅對社區有幫助，對學生自己也有益且方便。
deriv: convenience n. 方便；便利設施

words.zh: 感激的，感謝的
words.en: feeling or showing thanks
ex: She is grateful that she was able to ask her English professor for help.
她很感激自己能向英文教授求助。
roots: 感謝、令人愉快（拉丁文 gratus = pleasing）

words.zh: 預言，預測
words.en: a statement about what you think will happen in the future
ex: She wants the students to make predictions on the speed of fish.
她希望學生預測魚的游動速度。
roots: 說（拉丁文 dicere = say）；pre- = 事先
deriv: predictable a. 可預測的，可預見的
predictive a. 預測的，預言的

words.zh: 1. 欣賞，賞識 2. 感激 3. 領會，意識到 4. 增值
words.en: to recognize the value of something; to be thankful for something
ex: Teachers were more appreciated and valued by society in the past than they are nowadays.
過去老師比現在更受社會賞識和重視。
roots: 價格、價值（拉丁文 pretium = price）
deriv: appreciation n. 賞識；感激；理解；增值
appreciative a. 欣賞的；感激的

words.zh: 1. 鼓動 2. 鼓勵，激勵，支持 3. 促進，激發
words.en: to give someone support or confidence; to make something more likely
ex: Right, it's just going to encourage students to wait and do all of their studying at the end of the semester and you just can't learn it all in a few days.
沒錯，這只會助長學生拖延，把所有讀書進度都留到學期末，可是你不可能在短短幾天內學完所有東西。
roots: 心（拉丁文 cor = heart）；en- = 使，給人心 → 鼓勵

words.zh: n. 1. 範圍 2. 一系列 3. 山脈；v. 1.（在某範圍內）變動 2. 閒逛，散步
words.en: a set of different things of the same type; the limits between which something varies
ex: The student may be able to express a greater range of emotion than she realizes.
這位學生能表達的情感層次，也許比她自己意識到的更豐富。
colloc: in/within range of 在可及的範圍內
range from（在一定範圍內）變化

words.zh: 學期
words.en: one of the two periods that a school or college year is divided into
ex: The university has announced that starting with the fall semester, free tutoring will be available to all new students for their entire first year.
學校宣布從秋季學期開始，所有新生第一年都可享有免費課業輔導。
roots: 月（拉丁文 mensis = month）；se- = six，六個月
look: 開頭 sem- 一樣，都是校園字

words.zh: 1. 不太可能的 2. 難以相信的，不能信服的
words.en: not probably going to happen or be true
ex: This may be one of the factors, but it is unlikely to be the sole cause.
這可能是其中一個因素，但不太可能是唯一的原因。
deriv: unlikelihood n. 未必有，不可信

words.zh: 1. 正確的，恰當的 2. 合乎體統的，正當的
words.en: correct or suitable for a particular situation
ex: To start, a child may not work with an activity until the teacher has demonstrated its proper use.
首先，在老師示範正確使用方法之前，孩子不能開始任何活動。
roots: 自己的（拉丁文 proprius = one's own）

words.zh: 1. 日誌，日記 2. 雜誌，期刊
words.en: a written record of daily events; a serious magazine about a subject
ex: I'm not convinced journal writing is worthwhile in classes.
我不認為在課堂上寫日誌有價值。
deriv: journalism n. 新聞業，新聞工作

words.zh: 記住，背熟
words.en: to learn something so that you can remember it exactly
ex: Okay, and as part of this assignment we needed to memorize the names, you know, and certain key characteristics of the plants.
好，這份作業的一部分是要記住這些植物的名稱，以及它們的一些關鍵特徵。
deriv: memorable a. 值得紀念的，難忘的
memorial a. 紀念的，記憶的 n. 紀念物，紀念館

words.zh: a. 自願的；n. 志願者，志工；v. 自願做
words.en: a person who does work without being paid; to offer to do something
ex: I don't think volunteer hours should be required because many students already have limited free time.
我認為不該強制要求志工時數，因為很多學生的空閒時間本來就有限。
look: 開頭 vol- 一樣，意思無關
colloc: volunteer service/work 志願服務／志工活動
deriv: voluntary a. 自願的，志願的

words.zh: 1. 才能，天資 2. 人才
words.en: a natural ability to do something well
ex: The campus talent contest will be held next Saturday evening.
校園才藝比賽將於下週六晚上舉行。
deriv: talented a. 有天賦的，有才幹的

words.zh: 1. 參考（書目），引文 2. 推薦信（或人）3. 提及，涉及
words.en: a book or source you look at for information; a mention of something
ex: Yes, you can find it in the reference section.
是的，您可以在參考資料區找到它。
roots: 帶、搬運（拉丁文 ferre = carry）
colloc: for reference 以供參考；備查
in/with reference to 關於

words.zh: v. 1. 轉換，改變 2. 開或關（燈等）；n. 1. 改變，轉變 2. 開關 3. 鞭子
words.en: to change from one thing to another
ex: It was taking a lot out of him, so he switched to business.
這讓他耗費了大量精力，所以他轉去讀商科了。
colloc: switch off/on 關閉／開啟

words.zh: 使想起，提醒
words.en: to make someone remember something
ex: How many times do I have to remind you?
我到底要提醒你幾次啊？
colloc: remind sb. about/of sth. 使某人想起……

words.zh: 幫助，協助，援助
words.en: to help someone do something
ex: The help desk is available to assist with research questions.
服務台隨時可以協助解答研究相關問題。
roots: 站立（拉丁文 sistere = stand）；as- = 站在旁邊 → 幫忙
deriv: assistant a. 助理的，副的 n. 助理

words.zh: v. 使平衡，使均衡；n. 1. 平衡，均衡 2. 差額，餘額 3. 天平，秤
words.en: a state where things are equal or in the right amounts; to keep things equal
ex: Adding a mandatory volunteer requirement could create extra stress and make it harder for those students to balance their existing responsibilities.
增設強制性的志工規定可能加重學生負擔，讓他們更難平衡現有的責任。

words.zh: a. 1. 持續的 2. 穩定的，牢固的；v. 使穩固，使堅定
words.en: continuing or developing gradually and evenly; firmly fixed
ex: According to a university administrator, the decision was prompted by a steady decline in enrollments in evening classes.
據一位大學行政人員說，這個決定是因為夜間部的入學人數持續下降。
roots: 站、固定的位置（古英文 stede = place）
deriv: steadily ad. 穩定地，穩固地

words.zh: v.（使）灑出，（使）濺出，（使）溢出；n. 溢出，濺出
words.en: to accidentally let liquid or food fall out of a container
ex: Because if a student spilled food, there'd be a mess, or it might damage books and desks.
因為如果學生把食物灑出來，就會弄得一團糟，還可能弄髒書本、弄壞桌子。
colloc: spill into 湧進
spill out（使）溢出，（使）濺出；突然湧出；說出（真相、內情）
spill over 溢出
spill the beans 洩露秘密，說溜嘴

words.zh: 問卷，調查表
words.en: a written list of questions answered by many people to collect information
ex: Before they arrive on campus, all incoming students will fill out a questionnaire about their likes and dislikes and their habits.
入學前，所有新生都要填一份關於個人喜好和習慣的調查問卷。
roots: 尋求、詢問（拉丁文 quaerere = seek, ask）

words.zh: 之後（亦作 afterwards）
words.en: at a later time; after something has happened
ex: But, sometimes students like to watch with classmates, so they can review the material with each other afterward.
不過，有時學生喜歡跟同學一起看，之後就能一起複習這些資料。

words.zh: n. 1. 計畫，方案 2. 陰謀，詭計；v. 策劃，圖謀
words.en: an official plan; a clever and often dishonest plan
ex: Educators T. Wildman and J. Niles (1987) described a scheme for developing reflective practice in experienced teachers.
教育家 T. Wildman 和 J. Niles 在 1987 年提出一套在資深教師中推動反思實踐的方案。
colloc: propose a scheme 擬定一個計畫
deriv: schemer n. 密謀者，陰謀家

words.zh: 1. 查閱 2. 諮詢 3. 商量
words.en: to go to someone or something for information or advice
ex: He consulted a description of the course about Islamic art.
他查閱了一門伊斯蘭藝術課程的介紹。
roots: 跳、商議（拉丁文 consulere = take counsel）
colloc: consult with 商量，協商
deriv: consultation n. 諮詢，商討；查閱

words.zh: 1. 打斷（講話），插嘴 2. 使暫停，使中斷
words.en: to stop someone while they are speaking or doing something
ex: He does not want the students to interrupt him.
他不希望學生打斷他。
roots: 斷裂（拉丁文 rumpere = break）；inter- = 在中間
colloc: interrupt sb./sth. with sth. 以……干擾某人或某物
deriv: interruption n. 中斷時間；打擾

words.zh: 熱情的，熱心的，熱烈的
words.en: showing a lot of interest and excitement about something
ex: He is enthusiastic about planning activities.
他熱衷於規劃活動。
roots: 神（希臘文 theos = god）；en- + theos = 被神附身 → 狂熱
deriv: enthusiastically ad. 熱心地，滿腔熱忱地

words.zh: a. 1. 粗略的 2. 粗糙的 3. 粗暴的 4. 艱難的；n. 1. 草稿，草圖 2. 暴徒
words.en: not exact or detailed; having an uneven surface
ex: Hi, Melissa, your rough draft for your paper is looking very promising so far.
嗨，Melissa，你論文的初稿目前看起來很不錯。
deriv: roughly ad. 粗糙地；概略地

words.zh: n. 1. 貸款 2. 借，借出物；v. 借出，貸與
words.en: money that you borrow and must pay back
ex: I mean I have student loans that pay for most of the tuition, but well it's the everyday things that add up.
我是說，大部分學費靠學生貸款支付，但日常開銷積少成多，也是一筆不小的數目。
colloc: mortgage loan 按揭貸款，抵押貸款（房貸）
on loan 借來的，借出的；借調

words.zh: n. 評論，評述；v. 評論，談及
words.en: something you say or write that expresses an opinion
ex: I'll just say a few general remarks, so you get an overall picture.
我就簡單講幾句整體的看法，讓你們有個大概的了解。
deriv: remarkable a. 非凡的，顯著的

words.zh: n. 模式，版式，格式；v. 將（電腦磁碟）格式化
words.en: the way something is arranged or presented
ex: I'll still need you to submit the paper in the format we discussed in class.
我還是要你照課堂上討論的格式交論文。
roots: 形狀、形式（拉丁文 forma = shape）
colloc: format error 格式錯誤

words.zh: 堅信，確信
words.en: completely certain that something is true
ex: I'm not convinced that any one person's occasional visits to a classroom would provide accurate information.
我不相信某一個人偶爾到教室看一下，就能得到準確的資訊。
roots: 征服、獲勝（拉丁文 vincere = conquer）
look: -ed 是人確信，-ing 是事物有說服力
deriv: convince v. 使確信，使信服

words.zh: 估計，分析，評估
words.en: to judge the quality, value, or importance of something
ex: Let's discuss how teachers' job performance is assessed or evaluated.
我們來探討一下教師的工作表現是如何被評估或評價的。
roots: 坐（拉丁文 sedere = sit）；as- = 坐在旁邊 → 評估（法官助手）

words.zh: n. 1. 投影片，幻燈片 2. 滑動；v.（使）滑動，（使）滑行
words.en: one page of a presentation shown on a screen; to move smoothly over a surface
ex: Let's take a look at this slide to see how she had herself represented.
我們來看這張投影片，看看她是怎麼呈現自己的。
colloc: slide down 滑下
slide into 不知不覺地陷入，不知不覺地染上

words.zh: 研討會，（大學的）研討課
words.en: a class where a small group of students discuss a subject with a teacher
ex: I had to finish up a paper for my history seminar.
我那時得趕完歷史研討課的論文。
roots: 種子（拉丁文 semen = seed）；原指培育之地
colloc: seminar room 研討室

words.zh: 可選擇的，選修的
words.en: available to choose but not required
ex: For instance, under an optional-attendance policy, university students could choose not to attend classes.
例如在非強制出席的政策下，大學生可以選擇不去上課。
look: 開頭 opti- 一樣，意思不同

words.zh: 令人費解的，令人困惑的
words.en: difficult to understand; not clear
ex: Rules are sometimes confusing.
規則有時令人困惑。
roots: 倒、流（拉丁文 fundere = pour）；con- = 一起，倒在一起 → 混亂
look: -ed 是人感到，-ing 是事物令人
deriv: confused a. 糊塗的；難以理解的

words.zh: v. 回憶起，回想起；n. 回憶
words.en: to remember something from the past
ex: She cannot recall the supervisor's name.
她想不起指導員的名字了。

words.zh: 1. 費力的，費勁的 2. 雄心勃勃的，有抱負的
words.en: having a strong wish to succeed; needing a lot of effort and skill
ex: So Miranda, I take it you wanted to talk with me about the draft of your paper, Herbert Spencer, that's quite an ambitious subject.
那麼 Miranda，我猜你是想跟我談你論文的草稿，主題是 Herbert Spencer，這題目相當有挑戰性。
roots: 四處、兩邊（拉丁文 ambire = go around，原指四處拉票）
look: 開頭 ambi- 一樣，意思不同

words.zh: 1. 為……辯護 2. 證明……有理
words.en: to give a good reason for something; to show that something is right
ex: So, they chose to miss the class, but they justify it by explaining that they had to go to an important job interview.
所以他們選擇翹課，卻辯解說自己必須去參加一場重要的求職面試。
roots: 法律、正義（拉丁文 jus = law, right）
deriv: justified a. 有正當理由的

words.zh: v. 指責，責怪，歸咎於；n. 過失，責備
words.en: to say or think that someone is responsible for something bad
ex: Some people blame the Dean for not giving us more of a chance.
有些人責怪院長沒有多給我們一些機會。
colloc: put the blame on... 歸咎於……

words.zh: 1. 假定，假設 2. 承擔，擔任
words.en: something you accept as true without proof
ex: Students need to be careful to avoid designing experiments that are based on faulty assumptions.
學生要小心，避免設計出建立在錯誤假設上的實驗。
deriv: assume v. 假定，設想；承擔，就職；假裝，佯作

words.zh: 擴大，擴充，延長
words.en: extra time allowed to finish something; the act of making something bigger or longer
ex: I'm writing to request a two-day extension for the research paper.
我特此來信，申請把研究論文的繳交期限延長兩天。

words.zh: 1. 特別的，不一般的 2. 卓越的，非凡的
words.en: very unusual or special; much greater than usual
ex: The dean is very strict about granting extensions, except under extraordinary circumstances.
院長對延長截止日期非常嚴格，除非是特殊情況。
roots: 順序、秩序（拉丁文 ordo = order）；extra- = 超出

words.zh: n. 休息室；v.（懶散地）坐，躺，倚
words.en: a room where people can sit and relax
ex: The student lounge will be closed tomorrow from 1 P.M. to 3 P.M. for maintenance.
學生休息室明天下午 1 點到 3 點因維修關閉。

words.zh: v. 1. 閃現，掠過 2. 閃光；n. 1. 閃光，閃光燈 2. 手電筒；a. 突然且短暫的
words.en: to appear or shine suddenly for a very short time
ex: The slide would flash just for a fraction of a second.
投影片閃過的時間可能只有零點幾秒。
colloc: flash sb. a look/smile 瞥某人一眼／衝某人微微一笑
in a flash 轉眼間

words.zh: 足夠的，充足的
words.en: enough for a particular purpose
ex: The student does not have sufficient training to conduct a worthwhile experiment.
這名學生沒有足夠的訓練來進行一項有價值的實驗。
roots: 做（拉丁文 facere = do, make）；suf- = 在下面，做到夠

words.zh: 障礙（物），妨礙，絆腳石
words.en: something that blocks your way or makes progress difficult
ex: There are numerous obstacles to implementing reflection in schools and insufficient understanding of why teachers might want to reflect.
在學校推行反思有許多障礙，而且大家對教師為什麼要反思也缺乏足夠的認識。
roots: 站（拉丁文 stare = stand）；ob- = 對著，站在面前擋路
colloc: pose an obstacle to 成為……的障礙

words.zh: 隱私，私生活
words.en: the state of being alone or having your personal life kept secret
ex: These new units will allow students to have privacy and work in isolation and will therefore eliminate noise in the library so students can concentrate.
這些新隔間讓學生擁有私人空間、可以獨自讀書，也能消除圖書館裡的噪音，讓學生專心。
roots: 個人的、分開的（拉丁文 privus = single, own）
colloc: a person's right to privacy 個人隱私權
deriv: private a. 私有的，私人的

words.zh: v. [haʊz] 1. 給（某人）提供住處 2. 收藏，安置；n. [haʊs] 1. 房屋 2. 家庭 3. 機構，議院
words.en: (verb) to provide a place for someone to live or for something to be kept
ex: They house their participants in that dorm all summer.
他們安排參加者整個夏天住在那間宿舍。
colloc: in house 內部的
on the house 免費提供的

words.zh: 全面的，廣泛的，綜合的
words.en: including all or almost all the details or parts
ex: They were not as comprehensive as the current class.
它們不像現在的課程那麼全面。
roots: 抓住（拉丁文 prehendere = seize）；com- = 全部，全部抓住 → 全面的
look: 同字根，意思是「能被理解的」
colloc: comprehensive university 綜合大學
deriv: comprehensible a. 可理解的，易懂的

words.zh: 登記，註冊
words.en: to put your name on an official list
ex: Well, according to the register office you're still enrolled in it.
嗯，根據註冊組的紀錄，你仍在這門課的註冊名單中。
roots: 帶、記錄（拉丁文 gerere = carry）

words.zh: v. 招聘，吸收（新成員），徵募（新兵）；n. 新兵，新成員
words.en: to find new people to join a company, organization, or the armed forces
ex: Maybe let's try to recruit Michael and Sarah to come with us.
或許我們可以試著邀 Michael 和 Sarah 加入我們。
roots: 生長、增加（拉丁文 crescere = grow）；原意「重新長出」→ 補充新兵
colloc: an inexperienced recruit 沒經驗的新手
deriv: recruiter n. 招聘人員；徵兵人員

words.zh: a. 1.（高中或大學）畢業班的 2.（級別、地位等）較高的 3. 年長的；n. 1. 年長者 2. 上級，上司 3. 高年級學生
words.en: in the last year of high school or college; higher in rank
ex: Senior students will once again be paired with freshmen to help them navigate their first year.
高年級學生將再次與新生配對，幫助他們適應第一年的校園生活。
colloc: senior engineer 資深工程師

words.zh: 1. 批評，責難 2. 評論
words.en: to say what is wrong with someone or something
ex: When a teacher criticizes students they might feel bad about themselves, but they won't necessarily know what to do differently.
老師批評學生時，他們可能會對自己感覺不好，但不一定知道該怎麼改。
roots: 判斷、分辨（希臘文 krinein = judge）
deriv: critic n. 批評家；評論家

words.zh: n. 1. 榮幸，榮譽 2. 尊敬，尊重；v. 1. 給……以榮譽 2. 尊敬，尊重
words.en: great respect; a special award or privilege
ex: Whenever any of our students or faculty wins a national honor, it reflects well on our university.
每當我們的學生或教職員獲得國家級榮譽，都會為學校增光。
colloc: a sense of honor 榮譽感
deriv: honorable a. 光榮的；可敬的

words.zh: 1. 插圖，圖表 2. 解釋，說明
words.en: a picture in a book; an example that explains something
ex: You know, there's actually an illustration of one on, let's see page twelve of our handouts.
你知道嗎，我們講義上其實就有一張它的插圖，我看看，在第 12 頁。
roots: 光（拉丁文 lustrare = make bright）；il- = 照亮 → 說明
deriv: illustrate v. 表明，顯示；（用示例、圖畫等）說明，解釋；（為書）作插圖
illustrative a. 說明的，解釋性的

words.zh: n. 一部分，一份；v. 分配，劃分
words.en: a part of something larger
ex: I'm afraid that'll translate into an automatic failing grade for that portion of the exam.
恐怕這會讓那部分的考試直接被判不及格。
roots: 部分、份（拉丁文 portio = share）
colloc: portion sth. out 把……分成若干份

words.zh: v. 掌握，掌控；a. 精通的；n. 1. 大師，專家 2. 主人 3. 碩士
words.en: to learn how to do something very well
ex: Before students can enroll, they have to master some fairly complicated computer skills.
學生註冊前必須掌握一些相當複雜的電腦技能。
roots: 大（拉丁文 magister = teacher, master，源自 magis = more）
colloc: master degree 碩士學位
a master of 精通……的人

words.zh: 1. 論題，論點 2. 畢業（或學位）論文
words.en: a long piece of writing for a university degree; the main idea of an argument
ex: Darwin's original thesis, and the viewpoint supported by evolutionary gradualists, is that species change continuously but slowly and in small increments.
達爾文最初的論點，也是演化漸進論者支持的觀點，是物種會持續演變，但非常緩慢、每次變化很小。
colloc: graduate/master's/doctoral thesis 學士／碩士／博士論文

words.zh: 令人信服的，有說服力的
words.en: able to make you believe that something is true
ex: Third, the local study mentioned in the passage isn't very convincing either.
第三，文中提到的地方研究也不太有說服力。
look: -ed 是人確信，-ing 是事物有說服力
colloc: a convincing speech 令人信服的演講
deriv: convince v. 使確信，使信服
convinced a. 確信的，深信的

words.zh: 新聞業，新聞工作
words.en: the work of collecting and writing news for newspapers, TV, or websites
ex: I'll probably concentrate on journalism courses next semester.
我下學期可能會專攻新聞學課程。
roots: 一天（拉丁文 diurnus = daily）；每日記事 → 新聞
deriv: journal n. 日誌，日記；雜誌，期刊

words.zh: a. 每年的，年度的；n. 1. 年刊 2. 一年生植物
words.en: happening once every year
ex: Just a friendly reminder that the university's annual charity auction will take place tomorrow at 7 P.M. in the Main Hall.
溫馨提醒：學校年度慈善拍賣會將於明天晚上 7 點在大禮堂舉行。
colloc: annual budget 年度預算
deriv: annually ad. 每年，一年一次

words.zh: v. 1. 掃描 2. 瀏覽 3. 細看，審視；n. 掃描
words.en: to look at something quickly; to pass light over a document to copy it
ex: You can start here to scan your library card.
你可以從這裡開始掃描你的借書證。

words.zh: 1. 學者 2. 獎學金得主
words.en: a person who studies a subject in great detail, especially at a university
ex: We will also organize four panel discussions with leading scholars as well as interactive workshops.
我們還會舉辦四場邀請頂尖學者參與的專題座談，以及互動工作坊。
roots: 學校（希臘文 schole = leisure, school）
deriv: scholarly a. 學術的；有學問的

words.zh: 1. 靈活的，可變通的 2. 柔韌的，易彎曲的
words.en: able to change easily; able to bend without breaking
ex: Learn a new language, meet people from different cultural backgrounds, and swap languages in a fun, flexible, and relaxed way.
學一門新語言、認識來自不同文化背景的人，用有趣、靈活又輕鬆的方式交換語言。
deriv: flexibility n. 柔韌性；靈活性
flexibly ad. 柔韌地；靈活地

words.zh: v. 主辦，款待；n. 1.（電視等的）主持人 2. 東道主，主人 3.（寄生動植物的）宿主
words.en: to organize an event and welcome guests
ex: This year, we'll be hosting a charity bake sale next Friday in the Student Center.
今年我們將於下週五在學生活動中心舉辦一場慈善烘焙義賣。
roots: 客人、陌生人（拉丁文 hospes = guest, host）
colloc: a host of 許多，大量
host country 東道國，主辦國
play host to 招待

words.zh: v. 1. 打折出售 2. 低估，認為……不重要；n. 減價，折扣
words.en: a reduction in price; to consider something unimportant
ex: All textbooks, supplies and school merchandise will be discounted by 20%.
所有教科書、文具和校園周邊商品一律打八折。

words.zh: n. 報酬，回報，獎賞；v. 酬謝，獎賞
words.en: something given to someone for doing something good
ex: As a mentor, you'll gain real leadership experience and feel the reward of helping someone succeed.
擔任導師能累積實戰領導經驗，並體會幫助別人成功的滿足感。
deriv: rewarding a. 值得做的，有益的

words.zh: 1. 嚴峻的，嚴重的 2. 劇烈的 3. 嚴厲的，苛刻的
words.en: very bad or serious; very strict
ex: Due to the forecasted severe weather, the university has decided to cancel all classes and activities tomorrow.
根據天氣預報的惡劣天氣警報，學校決定取消明天所有課程和活動。

words.zh: 1. 證明，證書 2. 憑證，單據
words.en: an official document that proves something is true
ex: Additionally, all attendees will receive a conference packet, including materials from the sessions and a certificate of participation.
此外，所有與會者都會拿到會議資料包，內含各場次資料和參加證書。
colloc: a birth/death/marriage certificate 出生／死亡／結婚證明
gift certificate〈美〉禮券
deriv: certificated a. 授予證書的，合格的
certification n. 資格證書；證明，鑑定

words.zh: 1. 批准，認可 2. 贊成，同意
words.en: to officially agree to something; to think that something is good
ex: Maria expects the professor to automatically approve her request.
Maria 期望教授直接批准她的請求。
roots: 證明、測試（拉丁文 probare = test, prove）

words.zh: n. 1. 提綱，概要 2. 外形，輪廓；v. 1. 概述 2. 畫出……的輪廓
words.en: a description of the main points of something; the shape of something
ex: It looks like you haven't finished the outline for your research paper.
看來你還沒完成研究論文的大綱。

words.zh: 最後期限
words.en: a time or date by which something must be finished
ex: Maria believes technical problems excuse students from meeting deadlines.
Maria 認為技術問題可以作為學生沒能按時完成的理由。
colloc: meet the deadline 趕上最後期限，按期完成

words.zh: 1. 承諾，保證 2. 奉獻，投入
words.en: a promise to do something; dedication to a cause or activity
ex: Another strategy is to have the students make a commitment to follow the rule, to promise to obey the rule.
另一種策略是讓學生承諾遵守規則，保證服從規則。
roots: 送（拉丁文 mittere = send）；com- = 全部送出 → 投入
deriv: commit v. 投入，忠於；承諾，擔保；犯（錯誤），做（壞事）
committed a. 盡心盡力的，忠誠的

words.zh: 拍賣
words.en: a public sale where things are sold to the person who offers the most money
ex: We are thrilled to announce that the university's annual charity auction will be held next Saturday at 6:00 p.m. in the main hall.
我們很高興宣布，學校年度慈善拍賣會將於下週六晚上 6 點在大禮堂舉行。
roots: 增加（拉丁文 augere = increase）；價格一路往上加

words.zh: 1. 命令，指令 2. 授權
words.en: an official order to do something; the authority given to someone
words.mnem: mand (=order) + -ate → 命令，指令
ex: I think this mandate sounds good in theory, but it might be hard to implement.
我覺得這項指令理論上聽起來不錯，但可能很難落實。
deriv: mandatory a. 法律規定的；強制的

words.zh: 初步的，預備的，開端的
words.en: done at the beginning to prepare for something more important
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + limin (=threshold) + -ary → 開始之前的 → 初步的，預備的
ex: Absolutely! Maybe you should do some preliminary research on that.
當然！或許你應該先針對這個問題做些初步研究。
look: 開頭 pr- 意思也接近
colloc: preliminary to 為……做準備；先於

words.zh: 1. 實習工作 2. 實習期
words.en: a period of work, often for students, to gain experience
ex: Also, why don't you think about, you know, our department always has information about summer internships.
另外，你不妨考慮一下，我們系上一直都有暑期實習的資訊。
roots: 內部的（拉丁文 internus = inside）
deriv: intern n. 實習生 v. 實習

words.zh: v. 1. 理解，領會 2. 抓住，握住；n. 1. 緊握 2. 理解
words.en: to understand something; to hold something firmly
ex: Besides, I'm not sure if you really fully grasp what they teach in that writing class.
此外，我不確定你是否真的完全理解那門寫作課教的內容。

words.zh: 1. 延緩，推遲 2. 懸，掛，吊
words.en: to stop something for a period of time; to hang something from above
words.mnem: sus- (=under) + pend (=hang) → 掛著，晾著 →（引申）延緩，推遲
ex: Classes aren't suspended just because your parents happened to be visiting?
總不能因為你父母剛好來探望，課程就暫停吧？
colloc: suspend production 停產
suspend sb. from sth. 使某人暫時停職（或停學等）

words.zh: 1.（大學中院、系的）全體教師 2. 能力，才能
words.en: all the teachers in a university; a natural ability
ex: Each mentor is paired with a faculty advisor.
每位導師都會配一位教師顧問。
roots: 做（拉丁文 facere = do）；facultas = 做事的能力
colloc: a retentive faculty 記憶力

words.zh: 1. 眼界，視野 2. 地平線
words.en: the line where the earth seems to meet the sky; the limit of your knowledge or experience
ex: Grad school is an opportunity to widen your horizons, meet new people, different professors, maybe live in a new place.
讀研究所能讓你拓展視野、認識新朋友和不同的教授，甚至可能到新的地方生活。
colloc: on the horizon 很可能即將發生
deriv: horizontal a. 與地平線平行的，水平的

words.zh: 1. 學費 2. 指導，教學
words.en: money paid for being taught at a school or university
ex: He needs to set up a tuition payment plan.
他需要擬定一個學費繳納計畫。
roots: 照看、保護（拉丁文 tueri = watch over）

words.zh: 1. 撤退，退出 2. 提款，取款
words.en: the act of leaving or taking something back; taking money out of a bank
words.mnem: with- (=back) + draw (=draw) + -al → 往回拉 → 撤退，退出
ex: However, don't forget to file a formal withdrawal from Introduction to Art History with the registrar's office by Friday, when the withdrawal period ends.
不過，別忘了在週五退選期截止前，到教務處提交《藝術史導論》的正式退選申請。
deriv: withdraw v. 撤退，退出；提款，取款

words.zh: 正當理由，藉口
words.en: a good reason for doing something
words.mnem: just (=right) + i + fic (=make) + -ation → 使正確 → 正當理由，藉口
ex: I also often hear justifications when students explain why they missed a class.
我也常聽到學生解釋缺課原因時給的各種理由。
roots: 法律、正義（拉丁文 jus = law, right）
deriv: justify v. 證明……有理；為……辯護
justified a. 有正當理由的

words.zh: 不可避免的
words.en: impossible to prevent or avoid
ex: I'm afraid we're talking about something more on the order of illness, or if you had an unavoidable conflict, like an exam in another class scheduled for the same time.
恐怕我們說的比較像是生病這類情況，或是你遇到無法避免的衝堂，例如另一門課的考試排在同一時間。
colloc: an unavoidable accident 一次不可避免的事故

words.zh: n. [ˈdiːfekt] 缺點，瑕疵，不足之處；v. [dɪˈfekt] 背叛，叛變
words.en: a fault or problem in something
words.mnem: de- (=away) + fect (=do) → 做法不對 → 缺點，瑕疵
ex: I guess the defect of alarm clock wouldn't count as extraordinary.
我猜鬧鐘故障算不上什麼特別的事。
roots: 做（拉丁文 facere = do）；de- = 離開，沒做好 → 缺陷

words.zh: 出勤，出席
words.en: the act of being present at a place, such as school or a meeting
ex: One such proposal is to make class attendance optional.
其中一項提議是讓學生自己選擇要不要來上課。
roots: 伸展（拉丁文 tendere = stretch）；at- = 朝向，把心伸過去 → 出席

words.zh: 不足的
words.en: not enough for a particular purpose
words.mnem: in- (=not) + suf- (under) + fic (=do) + i + -ent → 做得不夠的 → 不足的
ex: She also noted that the university has a problem with insufficient study space for undergraduates.
她還指出，學校有大學部學生讀書空間不足的問題。

words.zh: 公告，公報
words.en: a short official announcement or news report
ex: She saw a positive review of the program posted on the bulletin board.
她看到公布欄上貼著對這個計畫的正面評價。
colloc: bulletin board 公布欄

words.zh: 1. 略過，跳過 2. 跳，跳躍 3. 快速轉換（話題）
words.en: to not do or attend something; to move by jumping lightly
ex: So I just eat something in my dorm before I leave or skip dinner altogether.
所以我出門前就在宿舍吃點東西，或乾脆不吃晚餐。
colloc: skip rope 跳繩

words.zh: 懊惱的，受挫的
words.en: feeling annoyed because you cannot do or get what you want
ex: Some students get frustrated easily and perceive this challenge to be insurmountable.
有些學生很容易感到沮喪，認為這個挑戰難以克服。
roots: 徒勞（拉丁文 frustra = in vain）
look: -ed 是人感到，-ing 是事物令人

words.zh: 1. 口頭的，口述的 2. 口腔的，口部的
words.en: spoken rather than written; relating to the mouth
ex: The final project for this course will be an oral presentation.
這門課的期末專題採口頭報告的形式。
roots: 嘴、說（拉丁文 os, oris = mouth）
look: 發音幾乎一樣，意思不同
colloc: oral language 口語

words.zh: a. 1. 光禿的，赤裸的 2. 最基本的，不加修飾的；v. 露出，暴露
words.en: not covered; basic, with nothing extra
ex: The grass is regularly trampled on and damaged by students playing games like soccer and Frisbee, resulting in ugly bare patches of dirt.
學生踢足球、玩飛盤等遊戲時，經常踐踏草皮，導致草皮受損，出現一塊塊難看的裸露泥地。
colloc: lay sth. bare 揭露，暴露
deriv: barely ad. 勉強可能；幾乎不

words.zh: 1. 提名，推薦 2. 任命，指派
words.en: to officially suggest someone for a position or prize
words.mnem: nomin (=name) + -ate → 提名，推薦
ex: There were only like ten winners out of several hundred college students from around the country who were nominated.
在全國各地被提名的數百名大學生中，只有大約十名得獎者。

words.zh: 即將來到的，即將出現的
words.en: happening soon
ex: Before we get started, I wanted to remind you of the guidelines for our upcoming short-story contest.
開始之前，我想提醒大家這次即將舉辦的短篇小說比賽的參賽規則。
colloc: the upcoming concert 即將上演的音樂會

words.zh: n. 目錄，名單；v. 編製目錄（英式拼法 catalogue）
words.en: a complete list of items, often with descriptions
words.mnem: cata- (=down) + log (=speak) → 把口述的內容記錄下來 → 目錄，名單
ex: They're still in the catalog, which means they can be checked out if you fill out a form.
它們仍在目錄中，也就是說只要填一張表就能借走。
roots: 說、話語（希臘文 logos = word）

words.zh: 1. 潛在的，可能的，預期的 2. 即將發生的
words.en: likely to happen or become something in the future
words.mnem: pro- (=forward) + spect (=look) + -ive → 未來看得見的 → 可能的
ex: We want to focus on improving the quality of life on campus to make the school more attractive to prospective students.
我們致力提升校園生活品質，讓學校對潛在的新生更有吸引力。
roots: 看（拉丁文 specere = look）；pro- = 向前看
look: 最常搞混：只差 pro- / per-
deriv: prospect n. 前景，預期；可能性，機會

words.zh: （大學）大學部學生
words.en: a university student who is studying for a first degree
ex: Western University allows undergraduate students with a high grade average to take courses in our graduate school programs.
韋仕敦大學允許平均成績優秀的大學部學生修讀本校研究所的課程。

words.zh: a. 1. 可靠的，明智的 2. 健全的，完好的；n. 聲音，響聲；v. 1. 發（音）2. 聽起來好像 3. 測（海或湖的）深度
words.en: (adjective) sensible and reliable; in good condition
ex: Wildman and Niles observed that systematic reflection on teaching required a sound ability to understand classroom events in an objective manner.
Wildman 和 Niles 指出，對教學做系統性反思，需要（教師）具備以客觀方式理解課堂事件的紮實能力。
look: 同一個字，最常見的意思
colloc: sound off 高談闊論，誇誇其談
deriv: soundly ad. 堅實地，牢固地

words.zh: 宿舍
words.en: a large building at a college where students live
words.mnem: dorm (=sleep) + it + -ory → 睡覺的地方 → 宿舍
ex: Let us direct you to your assigned dormitory hall.
我們帶您前往分配好的宿舍大樓。

words.zh: n. 1.（大學的）系主任 2.（會議）主席 3. 椅子；v. 擔任主席，主持（會議、討論等）
words.en: the person in charge of a university department or a meeting
ex: You have to meet with your department chair to outline a plan for the rest of your time here.
你必須去見系主任，規劃你接下來的修業計畫。

words.zh: 1. 實施，執行 2. 強迫，強制
words.en: to make people obey a rule or law
words.mnem: en- (=into) + force (=strong) → 在其中施加力量 → 執行；強制
ex: And no matter what the reason, any time a student shows up late, the teacher enforces this, won't let them in the class.
而且不管什麼原因，只要學生遲到，老師就會執行這條規定，不讓他們進教室。
roots: 力量、強壯（拉丁文 fortis = strong）
colloc: enforce obedience to an order 強迫服從命令

words.zh: 1. 人文學科 2. 人類（總稱）3. 人性 4. 人道，仁慈
words.en: the study of subjects like literature and history; all people
ex: This is certainly not the first time I've heard that one, mostly from students whose major areas of study are directed toward humanities.
這當然不是我第一次聽到這種說法，而且大多是從主修偏向人文學科的學生那裡聽到的。
roots: 人、土地（拉丁文 humanus = human）
deriv: humanitarian a. 人道主義的 n. 人道主義者

words.zh: 誤導的，引人誤解的
words.en: giving the wrong idea or impression
ex: It was misleading, because it reinforced an incorrect theory.
這具有誤導性，因為它強化了一個錯誤的理論。
deriv: mislead v. 誤導，引人誤解

words.zh: 課程大綱
words.en: a list of the topics covered in a course
words.mnem: syl- (=together) + lab (=seize) + -us → 抓住所有重點 → 課程大綱
ex: The syllabus was just posted.
課程大綱剛公布。

words.zh: 法定的，義務的，強制性的
words.en: required by a law or rule
words.mnem: mand (=order) + at + -ory → 法定的，強制性的
ex: Well, it's a nice idea, but making it mandatory will probably have the opposite effect from what the announcement says.
嗯，這想法不錯，但強制推行可能會產生跟公告說的完全相反的效果。

words.zh: 1. 富有成效的 2. 生產的，多產的
words.en: producing good results; making a large amount of something
words.mnem: pro- (=forward) + duct (=lead) + -ive → 生產的 → 富有成效的
ex: We appreciate your preparation and look forward to a productive discussion.
感謝您的準備，我們期待一場有成效的討論。

words.zh: n. 1. 小徑 2. 蹤跡，痕跡；v. 1.（被）拖，拉 2. 追蹤
words.en: a path through a forest or countryside
ex: We'll meet at 8:00 a.m. at the Student Center and head out to the trails together.
我們早上 8 點在學生活動中心集合，再一起出發去步道。
colloc: on the trail of 追蹤，尋找

words.zh: 1. 培訓，訓練，新生訓練 2. 目標，定向 3. 定位，方向 4. 信仰，傾向
words.en: a training period for new students or workers; the direction something faces
words.mnem: ori (=rise) + ent + -ation → 太陽升起的地方 → 定位，方向 → 明確自身定位 →（引申）培訓，訓練
ex: The program replaces orientation for freshmen.
這個計畫取代了新生訓練。
roots: 升起（拉丁文 oriri = rise）；太陽升起的方向 → 東方 → 定位
colloc: market orientation 市場導向

words.zh: 1. 登記，註冊 2. 招收，入伍（英式拼法 enrol）
words.en: to officially join a course, school, or organization
words.mnem: en- (=in) + roll (=roll) → 在名冊裡 → 登記，註冊
ex: He obtained a list of courses in which the student is enrolled.
他拿到一份學生已註冊課程的清單。
roots: 名冊、捲軸（拉丁文 rotulus = little wheel）
colloc: enroll in 參加；選課
deriv: enrollment n. 登記，註冊，入學人數
enrollee n. 入學者，被錄取者

words.zh: 著名的，聞名的
words.en: famous and respected
words.mnem: re- (=again) + nown (=name) + -ed → 名字反覆出現 → 著名的，聞名的
ex: I am excited to inform you that Dr. Cynthia Palmer, a renowned expert in environmental science, will be giving a guest lecture next Monday at 2 P.M. in Waldman Auditorium.
很榮幸通知各位，環境科學領域的知名專家 Cynthia Palmer 博士將於下週一下午兩點在 Waldman 禮堂舉辦客座講座。

words.zh: 極好的，絕妙的
words.en: very good; excellent
words.mnem: terr (=frighten) + -ific → 好到嚇人的 → 極好的
ex: There were a lot of terrific papers this year.
今年有許多出色的論文。

words.zh: 非常興奮的，極為激動的
words.en: extremely pleased and excited
ex: That will mean less studying time for me, which I'm not thrilled about.
那對我來說代表讀書時間變少了，我實在興奮不起來。
look: -ed 是人感到，-ing 是事物令人
deriv: thrill v.（使）興奮，（使）激動 n. 興奮，令人興奮的經歷
thrilling a. 非常令人激動的

words.zh: n. 選修科目；a. 1. 選舉的 2. 可選擇的
words.en: a course that a student can choose to take
words.mnem: e- (=out) + lect (=choose) + -ive → 選修科目
ex: And as elective, you could take some Pre-Law classes like Constitution Law.
至於選修課，你可以選一些法律預科課程，例如憲法。
roots: 選擇、收集（拉丁文 legere = choose, read）
colloc: elective course 選修課

words.zh: v. 搶救，挽救；n. 搶救出的財物，搶救
words.en: to save something from being damaged or lost
ex: And was there no way to salvage the experiment?
難道沒有辦法挽救這個實驗嗎？
roots: 救、安全（拉丁文 salvare = save）
colloc: salvage charges 救援費
salvage value 殘值，折餘值
deriv: salvageable a. 可搶救的，可挽回的

words.zh: 1. 直觀的，易懂的 2. 直覺的
words.en: easy to understand without explanation; based on feelings rather than facts
words.mnem: in- (=into) + tuit (=watch) + -ive → 能看到裡面 → 直觀的，易懂的
ex: They were easier to recall than neutral images, pretty intuitive, right?
它們比中性圖像更容易被回想起來，這很直觀，對吧？
roots: 看、照看（拉丁文 tueri = look at）

words.zh: 模範的，典型的
words.en: so good that it should be copied by others
words.mnem: ex- (=out) + empl (=take) + -ary → 拿出來當樣本的 → 模範的，典型的
ex: I say this because your work on the lab project was exemplary.
我這麼說是因為你在實驗室專案上的表現堪稱楷模。
deriv: exemplify v. 是……的範例；舉例說明

words.zh: n. 1. 準備 2. 課外作業 3. 預科生；v. 預備，準備
words.en: (informal) preparation; work done to get ready for something
ex: If you don't mind working in the kitchen, we've got some pretty flexible hours for students doing food prep work, anything from early morning to late afternoon.
如果你不介意在廚房工作，我們為做備料工作的學生提供彈性時段，從清晨到傍晚都可以。
colloc: prep school 私立預備學校；私立預科學校

words.zh: 理解，領會
words.en: to understand something fully, especially something difficult
words.mnem: com- (=with) + prehend (=seize) → 抓住要點 → 理解，領會
ex: It could also give the teacher an informal way to gauge how well students are comprehending the lessons.
這也能讓老師用一種非正式的方式，衡量學生對課程內容的理解程度。
deriv: comprehensible a. 可理解的，易懂的
comprehensive a. 綜合性的，全面的

words.zh: 扼要重述，概括
words.en: to repeat the main points of something
words.mnem: re- (=again) + cap (=head) → 扼要重述
ex: Okay, so let's recap from yesterday.
好，那我們來回顧一下昨天的內容。

words.zh: v. 1. 使忙於應付，使陷入困境 2. 淹沒；n. 沼澤，低地
words.en: to give someone too much to deal with; an area of wet land
ex: Professor, I know you're swamped with grading finals, but thanks for making the time today.
教授，我知道您正忙著改期末考卷，還是謝謝您今天抽出時間。
colloc: swamp gas 沼氣

words.zh: 未完成的，不完全的，不完整的
words.en: not finished or not having all its parts
words.mnem: in- (=not) + com- (=together) + plet (=full) + -e → 不完整的
ex: She has not yet formed any opinion about the study because it is incomplete.
她對這項研究還沒有任何看法，因為研究尚未完成。
deriv: incompletely ad. 不完全地，不徹底地

words.zh: 誤解，曲解
words.en: to understand something in the wrong way
ex: She thinks the researchers misinterpreted the high-pitched barks as warning signals.
她認為研究人員把高聲吠叫誤解成了警報訊號。

words.zh: 1. 禮堂，會堂 2. 觀眾席，聽眾席
words.en: a large room or building where people watch performances or listen to talks
words.mnem: audit (=hear) + -or + -ium → 聽講的地方 → 禮堂，會堂；觀眾席
ex: Our event is in the auditorium.
我們的活動在禮堂舉行。

words.zh: （大房間隔出的）小房間，隔間
words.en: a small space separated from the rest of a room by low walls
words.mnem: cub (=lie) + -icle → 躺下休息的地方 → 小房間，隔間
ex: This summer, the tables will be exchanged for new personal study cubicles—small, one-person desks enclosed by walls.
今年夏天，這些桌子會換成全新的個人讀書隔間——用牆圍起來的單人小書桌。
roots: 躺（拉丁文 cubare = lie down）
colloc: a shower cubicle 淋浴間

words.zh: 1. 踩，踏 2. 侵犯，踐踏
words.en: to step heavily on something and damage it
ex: Unfortunately, though, the grass is regularly trampled on and damaged by students playing games like soccer and Frisbee.
不過可惜的是，學生踢足球、玩飛盤等遊戲時，經常踐踏草皮，導致草皮受損。
look: 只差一個母音和 p / b

words.zh: 先決條件，前提
words.en: something that must exist or happen before something else is possible
words.mnem: pre- (=before) + re- (=again) + quisit (=ask) + -e → 事先要求的東西 → 先決條件，前提
ex: Well, professor Campbell waived the prerequisite in my case, because he felt that I had enough background in art history to handle his course.
嗯，Campbell 教授破例免除了我的先修課程，因為他認為我在藝術史方面有足夠的背景知識，可以跟上他的課。
roots: 尋求、要求（拉丁文 quaerere = seek）
colloc: prerequisite course 先修科目，預修課程

words.zh: 試演，試唱，試聽（試鏡）
words.en: a short performance to show whether someone is good enough for a role
words.mnem: audit (=hear) + -ion → 試演，試唱，試聽
ex: You know, it is so hard to get into this group—I must have auditioned like ten times since I have been at the school.
你知道嗎，要加入這個團體非常難——我入學以來大概參加過十多次試演了。

words.zh: 1. 資格證書 2. 證明，鑑定
words.en: an official document or process that proves you have certain skills
words.mnem: cert (=sure) + i + fic (=make) + -ation → 證明，鑑定 → 資格證書
ex: You spent two years studying for your teaching certification, but you don't actually pay for the school.
你花了兩年考教師資格證書，但其實不用付學費給學校。
deriv: certificate n. 憑證，單據；證明，證書
certificated a. 授予證書的，合格的

words.zh: 1. 音響效果 2. 聲學
words.en: the way sound travels in a room; the scientific study of sound
ex: It used to be the college gym; the acoustics are terrible.
這裡以前是大學的體育館，音響效果非常糟。
deriv: acoustic a. 聲音的，聽覺的
acoustically ad. 聽覺上地，聲學上地

words.zh: 部分重疊，與……交叉
words.en: to cover part of the same area or subject as something else
ex: We find that elements of biology, psychology, and other sciences often overlap as we study particular phenomena.
我們發現，研究特定現象時，生物學、心理學和其他學科的原理經常互相重疊。

words.zh: 遷移，搬遷
words.en: to move to a new place, or to move someone or something there
words.mnem: re- (=again) + loc (=place) + -ate → 再度放置 → 遷移，搬遷
ex: Due to the upcoming construction work near our building, our class will be relocated to Room 210 starting next Monday.
由於我們大樓附近即將施工，我們班從下週一開始搬到 210 教室上課。
roots: 地方、放置（拉丁文 locus = place）
look: 多了 al-，是分配不是搬家

words.zh: 線上研討會，線上講座
words.en: an online seminar or presentation
ex: They can view the webinar content offline.
他們可以離線觀看線上研討會的內容。

words.zh: v. 展示，展現；n. 1. 玻璃櫥窗 2. 展示場所
words.en: to show the best qualities of something; a glass case for displaying things
ex: There will be exhibits from various departments showcasing innovative projects in the fields of biology, physics and chemistry.
各學系會有展覽，展示生物、物理和化學領域的創新專案。

words.zh: 亭，攤位
words.en: a small enclosed space or stand, for example at a fair
ex: Welcome to the student information booth.
歡迎來到學生資訊服務台。

words.zh: 1. 適得其反 2. 回火，逆火
words.en: to have the opposite effect from what was intended
ex: Studying nonstop can backfire.
不間斷地讀書可能會適得其反。

words.zh: 1. 充電 2. 休息，恢復精力
words.en: to fill a battery with electricity again; to rest and get your energy back
ex: Additionally, the university could add a number of electrical outlets to the room so students could recharge their laptops there.
此外，學校可以在房間裡加裝一些插座，讓學生在那裡幫筆電充電。
colloc: recharge your batteries 養精蓄銳，休息

words.zh: 過於擁擠的
words.en: having too many people or things in a place
ex: The proposal to add the classes is a response to student complaints that daytime computer classes have become increasingly overcrowded and there are no longer enough computers available.
增班的提議是回應學生的抱怨：白天的電腦課越來越擠，電腦也不夠用了。
deriv: crowded a. 擁擠的；充滿的
